summary: Jira MCP setup pending — need Atlassian API key
body: Package: mcp-atlassian (npm). Config goes in ~/.copilot/mcp-config.json alongside github-aikb entry. Needs: ATLASSIAN_URL, ATLASSIAN_EMAIL, ATLASSIAN_API_TOKEN env vars. Get API key from https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens. Will give Confluence read + Jira query access.
